title: Additive Hom identifications and maps for the open-cover triangle
statement: Let R be the underlying sheaf of rings of (X,O_X), with an explicit equality identifying R with O_X after forgetting commutativity. Let (X,O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], U,V open with U∪V=X, and E,F in D(O_X) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let RU,RV,RW denote the exact additive derived restriction functors, W=U∩V. There are objects A,B, morphisms a:A→B, b:B→E, δ:E→A[1], and a distinguished triangle A→B→E→A[1]. There are additive isomorphisms eB:Hom_X(B,F)≃Hom_U(E|U,F|U)×Hom_V(E|V,F|V), eA:Hom_X(A,F)≃Hom_W(E|W,F|W), and eN:Hom_X(A[1],F)≃Hom_W(E|W,(F|W)[-1]). They satisfy eB(b∘f)=(RU(f),RV(f)), and eA(a∘g)=res_{W,U}((eB(g))_1)−res_{W,V}((eB(g))_2), where the restrictions are conjugation by the canonical derived comparison isomorphisms for nested opens. This statement asserts geometric triangle data and Hom identifications only; it does not assert exactness of any Hom sequence.

source.place: Tags 08BU, 08BT and 08BW; canonical triangle and adjunction identifications before applying Hom exactness

proof.text: Obtain left adjoints to each derived restriction by specializing [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] to the topological site and lifting its adjunction on cochain complexes by Mathlib Adjunction.localization. Both termwise functors preserve quasi-isomorphisms by exactness. Use [lem-sc-open-cover-adjunction-triangle] for the canonical triangle in these adjunctions.

Construct eB by the biproduct Hom additive equivalence followed by the two homAddEquiv maps; construct eA from the overlap adjunction. Construct eN by the shift equivalence adjunction, the overlap adjunction, and postcomposition with the restriction shift comparison. The right triangle identities give the restriction formula for b. For a use naturality of homEquiv on the right, cancellation of homEquiv with its inverse, and naturality of c_U,c_V to compute the two transposes. Additivity and the negative V component give the difference formula. All this generic categorical calculation is proved in private helpers of the module.

proof_origin.note: One geometric reduction; all additive Hom equivalences and map identities proved, avoiding cyclic planned imports.
